title: Seam Taping
content: **List of Contents** Seam Taping Apply Seam Taping Seam Taping Properties **Seam Taping** \- Apply Seam Tapes to Pattern outlines to prevent stretch due to gravity. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022652428) **Seam Taping** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Or, navigate to the Main Menu and select Materials ▶ **Seam Taping.** ** Apply Seam Taping** \- With the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022652428) **Seam Taping** tool activated, select the Pattern outline to apply the Seam Tape. \- The segment line with seam tape is highlighted in orange color. \- Click the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022588847) **Simulation** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- The 3D Garment’s drape will change in the 3D window according to the application. **Seam Taping Properties** \- Use the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022589467) **Edit Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022652428) **Seam Taping** tool to select the desired Seam Tape applied to the Pattern outline. - The selected Seam Tape’s properties will appear in the Property Editor. \- **Width** : edit the width of the Seam Tape. \- **Preset** : choose the Seam Tape’s preset from the provided options. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for applying and customizing seam taping in garment design to enhance fabric integrity and prevent stretching.

title: Rectangle
content: **List of Contents** Rectangle Create **Rectangle** \- Create a rectangle Pattern in the 2D window. \- Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Rectangle** \- 2DToolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_2D_Shape_Square.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001195147/Toolbar_2D_Shape_Square.png)**Rectangle** **Show/Hide Size Group** * **Create** \- Click and drag in the 2D window to create a rectangle Pattern. \- To create a square Pattern, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard while click and drag. * **Create with Specific Values** \- To create a rectangle Pattern with specific values, click on the 2D window. \- The Create Rectangle window appears. * Size Set width and height of the rectangle. * Replicate Interval: Set the distance between each replicated rectangles. Angle: Set the angle of each replicated rectangles. Number of Shapes: Decide the number of replicated rectangles. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on how to create and customize rectangle patterns in the 2D window using specific tools and settings.

title: Slash & Spread
content: **List of Contents** Slash & Spread Fullness (Line) **Objective** Slash and spread a Pattern at a particular point or spread a particular area evenly based on selected segments. **Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Fullness (Point)** or **Fullness (Line)** 2D Toolbar ▶ Hold down ![Fullness_Point.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057904033/Fullness_Point.png) **Fullness (Point)** **▶![Fullness_Point.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057904033/Fullness_Point.png) Fullness (Point) **or**![Fullness_Line.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360057046394/Fullness_Line.png) Fullness (Line)** **Operation** **Fullness(Point)** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated 2. Click a start point and endpoint on Pattern Outlines to draw a slash line or select an Internal Line/ Baseline. → The Pattern is divided based on the slash line. The direction of the arrow will be the one that spreads out. 3. Click the side or baseline to rotate and move the mouse cursor in the direction you want to rotate. → The pattern spreads out the corresponding distance and angle. 4. Right-Click during rotation to directly enter the distance and angle. → It rotates according to the entered value. → If the pattern has internal lines, the internal lines area also moved and rotated along with the pattern. **※ Note:** A natural Curve is applied by default when the pattern is cut. You can keep the original curvature by pressing the D key on your keyboard. (ver 6.2) **Fullness (Line)** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click a start point and endpoint on Pattern Outlines to create a fullness line. → A fullness line is selected. 3. Click a start point and endpoint on Pattern Outlines to create a slash line. → The Fullness (Line) window appears. 4. Configure Direction and Length and click **OK**. → Fullness is evenly added to the Pattern according to the input values. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide on using the Slash & Spread Fullness tools in 2D pattern editing to evenly distribute fullness at specified points or lines in your designs.

title: Alvanon Avatar (AVAC) Open
content: ### **Objective** Load purchased certified Alvanon Avatar into CLO. **📝****Note:** To successfully load an Alvanon Avatar, it must go through a certification process. Loading an avatar without certification will restrict simulation and file saving. **Location**** **Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Open ▶**Avatar** (Ctrl+Shift+A) **Operation** 1. Click the tool/menu in Location → The Open File window will appear. 2. Select the Alvanon Avatar file to be loaded and select **OK**. → Alvanon authentication window will appear. 3. Complete the certification process by entering of **Alvanon Body platform** ID/FW → If certified successfully, the avatar will be loaded.
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for loading a certified Alvanon Avatar into CLO, ensuring proper certification to enable full simulation and file-saving capabilities.

title: Compatible with Wacom 3D Pen (ver 6.0)
content: Wacom 3D Pen Settings How to Control View in CLO Recommended Pen and Touch Settings for windows **Objective** Control the view of the screen with the Wacom Pro Pen (2D) and 3D Pen without any key combination. **Location** Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ View Control ▶ **Wacom Pen** ** Operation** **Wacom 3D Pen Settings** 1. Click the **Start** button. 2. Type **Wacom Tablet Properties** and click on the first search result. 3. My devices ▶ Click the tablet connected ▶ Click the Pen settings. 4. In the **Wacom Tablet Properties** Window click on the **Pen** in the tool list. ![image-20201124-124053.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360099288374/image-20201124-124053.png) 5. Click on the plus "+" button to add an application profile. ![image-20201124-124201.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000416982/image-20201124-124201.png) 6. Click on the **Browse** button in the new window to locate CLO executable and click **OK** button. ![image-20201124-124249.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000417002/image-20201124-124249.png) 7. Set the pen button settings according to the recommended configuration for each of them. Wacom Pro Pen 2 | Wacom Pro Pen 3D ---|--- ![2d_pen.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000416682/2d_pen.png) | ![3d_pen.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/1500000424761/3d_pen.png) How to Set Space Bar: Click the dropdown menu ▶ Keyboard ▶ Modifier ▶ Keys ▶ Check on 'Space Bar' **** **How to Control View in CLO** 1. Control the view in the following way. **Move** | Hold down the middle button while hovering, move the pen on the tablet. ---|--- **Zoom** | Hold down the middle button while the pen tip is touching the device and move the pen in the vertical direction. **Rotate** | Hold down the bottom button while the pen tip is touching or placing close to the device, move the pen to rotate. **Simulate** (Pro Pen 3D Only) | Press the top button once to turn on the simulation and press once again to turn it off. **Select Mesh (Brush)** (Ver 6.1) | When using the Select Mesh (brush) tool, resize the area where the mesh is selected based on the pressure of the pen on the tablet screen. **※Note:** Use another key (e.g. Alt) on the keyboard with the pen to control the view in the 5.2 or lower versions. **** **Recommended pen and Touch Settings for Windows.** 1. Click the **Start** button. 2. Type **Control Panel** and click on the first search result. 3. Switch the Control Panel **display mode** to a **small icon**. 4. Click on **Pen and Touch** settings. **Double-tab** | Double-click (Default Value) ---|--- **Press and hold** | Select the row ▶ Click ‘**Settings** ’ ▶Check off ‘**Enable press and hold for right-clicking**. **Pen Buttons** | Check on both menus below. * Use the pen button as a right-click equivalent. * Use the top of the pen to erase ink (where available).
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for configuring Wacom 3D Pen settings to enhance view control in CLO without the need for keyboard shortcuts.

title: 3D
content: **Objective** Change the default settings of the software in **User Settings**. Designated settings will become the default after the program is restarted. Shortcut keys, menus, graphics options, view controls, default files, font settings, and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. In the 3D section, configure settings related to 3D features. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶**3D** ** Operation** 1. Adjust the settings below as needed: Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ **3D ** **Mesh** | Set the default mesh setting to **Triangle** or **Quad**. ---|--- **Arrangement** **** | Default Arrangement Shape Type | Arrange the pattern as curved or flat around the bounding volume of the Avatar when placing patterns around the avatar with arrangement points. Default Arrangement Point Size | Modify the default arrangement point size (radius). For smaller avatars, the default arrangement point size may hinder pattern arrangement, so decrease the size of the arrangement points for efficient pattern arrangement. Sync Fold Arrangement Angle | When using the [Fold Arrangement tool](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000483547-%EC%A0%91%EC%96%B4-%EB%B0%B0%EC%B9%98), change the selected Internal Line or Pattern Outline's Fold Angle accordingly (ver4.2.0). **Gizmo** | **Unified Gizmo** : Select, move, and rotate with a single Gizmo tool. **Divided Gizmo** : Select (Q), Move (W), Rotate (E) are divided into separate Gizmo tools. The Divided Gizmo tool automatically reassigns the **Pin** shortcut key from W to P on the keyboard. If P is already in use as a shortcut key, a shortcut key will not be applied to **Pin** (ver2.5.0).
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for users to customize their software's default settings, particularly focusing on the 3D features and arrangement options to enhance user experience.

title: Fix Grid Display
content: ### **Objective** This option is to fix the grid spacing regardless of the zoom of the 2D window, which makes it easier to recognize the magnification or reduction of the 2D window. ** Location ** Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 2D window) ▶ **Grid Properties**(ver3.2 or earlier) Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 3D/2D Window ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 2D window) ▶ **Grid Properties**(ver3.2 or earlier) Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on the 3D/2D Window ▶ **Grid Properties (F12)** (ver4.0 or later) → The properties related to the 2D window appear in the Property Editor. 2. 2D Grid ▶ Show 2D Grid ▶ Turn On → **Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom** appears in Property Editor. 3. **Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom** ▶ On/Off → When the Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is activated, the grid zooms in and out automatically as the 2D window zooms in and out. On the other hand, when the Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is deactivated, the grid is fixed and maintains its assigned size. **※ Note:** The Auto Adjust Distance with Zoom option is activated by default.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on adjusting grid properties in the 2D window to maintain consistent grid spacing regardless of zoom levels for improved visual clarity.

title: Wind Controller Setting
content: ### **List of Contents** #### **Properties** #### **Direction and Range Settings** #### **Add and Duplicate** #### ### **Objective** Adjust and apply wind effect to create fluttering effect on garment in the 3D window. ### ** ****Location** Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Environment ▶****Show Wind Controller** ** 3D Window ▶ Environment Display Icon **▶**Show Wind Controller**** ### ** ****Operation** #### **Properties** 1. Select the tool indicated in Location. → The Wind Controller appears in the 3D window. 2. Click the Wind Controller. → Wind Controller Gizmo activates. → Wind Controller properties appear in the Property Editor. 3. Adjust the default values at Property Editor according to the needs. **Option** | **Description**** ** ---|--- **Name** | Set the name of the Wind Controller. **Activate** | Set the activation status of the wind. **Unlimited Bound** **(ver 2024.0)** | Set the range of influence of the wind. By default, the wind effect is applied to the entire 3D window, and if you turn this option off, you can directly adjust the range of wind influence with the gizmo and apply it only to the set area. **Type** | Set the type of the wind. **Spherical** | The wind blows in spherical shape, in every direction starting from the Wind Controller. **Planar** | The wind blows only from the designated direction, regardless of the Wind Controller's location. **Strength** | Set the intensity of the wind. The higher the value, the stronger the wind. **Decay ** **[0~100]** | Set the range of the wind. The wind draws an arc and blows weaker according to the set value of wind intensity. If the value is "0", it blows in a straight line endlessly. **Frequency (sec)** | Set the cycle of the wind. The wind repeatably blows weaker and stronger in interval of set value of seconds. If the value is "0", it blows regularly. **Turbulence ****(Turbulence)** | Set the turbulence of wind intensity. The higher the value, the more irregular the wind intensity. **Translate** | Adjust the location of the Wind Controller by entering X, Y, and Z axis values. #### **Direction and Range Settings** 1. Click the Wind Controller and use the gizmo to adjust the wind location. 2. Click the scale icon at the top right of the gizmo. → It is switched to a scale gizmo that allows you to adjust the area of influence of the wind. **📝****Note:** The wind area can only be adjusted when the "Unlimited Bound" option in the Wind Property Editor is turned off. 3. Use the gizmo to control the area of influence of the wind. → The adjusted area is displayed immediately. 4. Click the **Simulation**. → The Wind Effect is now being activated as adjusted in the 3D window. #### #### **Create and Duplicate** 1. Click the Object Browser ▶ Scene tab ▶ Environment ▶ Wind. → A list of Wind Controllers is displayed. 2. On the top-level item in the wind, right-click ▶ **Create Wind Controller** menu. → A new Wind Controller is created. 3. Otherwise, right-click on an already-added wind item and click the **Duplicate** menu. → It is duplicated as a Wind Controller with the same properties as the selected wind. **📝****Note:** You can also duplicate by right-clicking on the wind controller in the 3D window. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide a comprehensive guide for adjusting and applying wind effects to create a fluttering effect on garments within the 3D environment.

title: Set View Control
content: **Objective** Change the default settings of the software menu according to user preference in User Settings. Upon restarting, the user settings of the software becomes the default settings. Shortcut keys, menus, graphic options, view controls, and other miscellaneous properties can be set in User Settings. **Location** Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶**View Control** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Settings ▶ User Settings ▶ **View Control** **※ Note: **A key and mouse control combination can be set for one function. If a combination is repeated, the interface may not work properly. **Preset** | Select one of the default presets. ---|--- **Pan** | Select a key and mouse combination for moving the screen. **Zoom** | Select a key and mouse combination for zooming in or out the screen. **Rotate** **(3D Window)** | Select a key and mouse combination for rotating the screen. **Popup Menu** | Select a key and mouse combination for opening the pop-up menu of the 3D Window. **Others** | Axis Constraint Key | Select the key that is used to move items across a constrained horizontal axis, vertical axis, or 45º angle. Smart Panning | Toggle on/off the option to Pan automatically based on the location of the mouse cursor while using certain functions. (Ver .2.5.0) Auto Focus (ver5.0.0) | Toggle on to automatically change the 3D window's focus point based on the user's click. Switch back focus to the default when unselected: The 3D window's focus point returns to all objects when an object is not selected. This option only appears when the **Auto Focus** is toggled ON. **View Point** | Default Y-Axis Position | Set the default position of the Y-Axis. Default X-Axis Position | Set the default position of the X-Axis. Default Camera Distance for Viewpoint Shortcuts (ver4.2.0) | Set the distance between the object and the camera when using the shortcut for view control. Change this setting when the default distance is too far away from the small object. **※ Note:** **Right-Clicks on a MAC** By default, right-clicks are disabled on Macs (Magic Mice, as well as others.) However, the right-click gives you access to important pop-up menus in CLO. You can easily enable right-clicks for your Mac mouse by following the instructions below: 1. Navigate to **System Preferences** (either from your dock or from the Apple menu on the top left hand corner of the screen.) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005447827/______1.png) 2. Select **Mouse**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005496028/______2.png) 3. The **Secondary Click (Click on right side)** option will be unchecked. Check it to enable right-clicks. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005447847/______3.png)
content_description: Customize your software experience by adjusting the default settings in User Settings to match your preferences, including shortcut keys and view controls.

title: Smart Guide
content: ### **Objective** Activate **Smart Guide** to easily create and move Patterns and Internal Shapes using surrounding points as guidelines (ver3.0.0). **Location** Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ **Smart Guide** Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) ▶ **Smart Guide** ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Preferences ▶ **Smart Guide** Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on 2D Window) ▶ **Smart Guide** → The option is activated/deactivated. 2. Create and move Patterns and Internal Shapes while **Smart Guide** is activated. → The selected Pattern/Internal Shape is guided and snap to the surrounding points.
content_description: The purpose of this web page is to provide instructions for activating the Smart Guide feature, enabling users to effortlessly create and move Patterns and Internal Shapes using surrounding points as alignment guides.

title: Show Simulation Speed
content: ### **Objective** Check Simulation Speed of CLO on device in use. Recommended Simulation Speed for running CLO is between 25 and 30 FPS when simulating the pre-loaded default garment. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ Display ▶ Environment ▶ **Show Frame Rate** ** Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → The Simulation Speed displays at the bottom-left corner of the 3D window. 2. Simulate. → Simulation speed, number of patterns, trims, and sewing lines(ver 6.2) are displayed.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for checking and optimizing the simulation speed of CLO on your device, ensuring it operates effectively between 25 and 30 FPS.

title: What other services do you have other than CLO?
content: **Question** Can I share CLO files with people who don't use CLO? Can I get additional CLO assets such as patterns, avatars, accessories, and fabrics? **Answer** We have other programs that you can utilize with CLO: CLO-SET and CLO-SET Connect. [**CLO-SET**](https://style.clo-set.com/) is an online cloud platform where you can share and communicate with your 3D Garments. [**CLO-SET CONNECT**](https://connect.clo-set.com/)is an online marketplace where anyone who has a CONNECT account can buy and sell digital clothes. Through the CONNECT platform, you can find and download a various type of patterns, avatars (poses and motions), accessories, fabrics, and scenes for free or for charge. If you have any inquiries about CLOSET and CONNECT in terms of account, billing, or any technical issues, please refer to the [CLO-SET Help Center](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us) or [contact us](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/requests/new). *CLO and CLO-SET are different service platforms and provide separate products, so you will need to purchase each product separately
content_description: This web page aims to inform users about sharing CLO files with non-CLO users and accessing additional CLO assets through CLO-SET and CLO-SET Connect.

title: Adjust Avatar Size
content: **Objective ** Create an avatar with your own measurements. As CLO Avatar Editor is powered by thousands of real body scan data, even measurements not assigned by users automatically adjust to the most realistic body shape. ** ****Location **** **Main Menu ▶Avatar ▶ Avatar Editor ▶**Avatar Size** ** ****Operation** 1. Load an [Avatar (.avt)](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002687268). 2. Select the tool/menu indicated.** **→ Measures appear on the Avatar. The editable measures appear in black, whereas the non-editable measures appear in grey. 3. Refer to below graph and adjust the Avatar as needed. **Option** | **Description**** ** ---|--- **Avatar Size ** | Easily select the size of the avatar in the Avatar Size Editor. **Total Body**** **| Shape the overall body type with Avatar's height and chest width. In order to get realistic shapes for body parts without assignable measurements, use the Total Body option to create an overall shape and then insert measurements under the Details option. **Height** | Assign Avatar's height. Because each person has a different head size, it is most accurate to create a full body shape based on HPS Height or Inseam. Total Height is the least accurate and is not recommended. **Total Height** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the head. **HPS Height** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the neck. **Inseam** | Insert the height measured from the ground to the crotch. **Proportion (ver 7.2 [![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/26258263192089)](https://youtu.be/CwB8_ad328M?si=QRMvussOAoDZ_aMm&t=1447))**** ** | Adjust the ratio of the avatar's upper and lower body. **Inseam** | Once the height between the floor and the legs is entered, the upper body automatically adjusts proportionally. **CF Neck to Waist** | Once the height from the Front Neck Point to the waist is entered, the lower body automatically adjusts proportionally. **Width** | Shape the overall body type based on Bust/ Under Bust Circumference, Weight. **Weight (ver 7.1)** | Enter the weight to set its overall body width. After entering the weight, select the desired total body shape and it will be changed to the corresponding body shape. **Details**** **** **| Configure Avatar's detailed measurements. A small error may be generated when entering measurements, and the error appears right next to each measurement. The actual applied measurements are displayed in the [Avatar Measurement](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055394453-Avatar-Measure-ver-6-0-) , so edit them more accurately by referring to them. **Basic** | Adjust the value of the basic body measurements. Body measurements that cannot be adjusted are automatically changed to realistic body shapes based on actual data according to the adjusted measurements. **Advanced** | Adjust the value of detailed body measurements. Advanced has more adjustable body measurments, but this may be more unnatural than the Basic option, as other measurements are not automatically adjusted and are fixed to the entered values. **Simple (ver 7.1)** | When changing the width based on weight, simply adjust the size of the minimized body measurements. **Show All Measurements** | Click the button at the top right of Details to check the all measurements. **Open/ Save** | Open or save the avatar size measurements. **Reset** | Reset the avatar's size to the default state.
content_description: Create a personalized avatar with accurate body measurements using our CLO Avatar Editor, which utilizes real body scan data for realistic adjustments.

title: Topstitch Right-Click Pop-Up Menu
content: ### **Objective** Edit topstitch using the right-click pop-up menu. ### **Location** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Topstitch ▶ Edit Topstitch 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360002922448/Toolbar_Common_Stitch_Edit.png) **Edit Topstitch** ### **Operation** 1. Click the tool/menu indicated. ** ** 2. Right click on the Topstitch to be edited. → The right-click pop-up menu appears. 3. Choose the desired option referring to the following table. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Select All with Same Property** | Select the topstitches having the same properties as the selected topstitch. **Assign to New Topstitch** | Assign the new topstitch to the selected topstitch. **Delete** | Delete the topstitch **Add Internal Line on Topstitch** | Create an Internal Shape right on top of the selected topstitch. **Remove Linked Editing** | Remove the linked editing of the symmetric topstitches. **Order (ver 7.0)** | Change the order of overlapping topstitches.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for editing topstitches using the right-click pop-up menu in the CLO 3D software.
